description: Live/inactive status for the selected fleet, pad, and optional well based on latest merged well-index timestamp.
sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH scoped AS (SELECT CAST(last_record_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_record_ts FROM featurestore:merged_well_index_v1 WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(fleet_name, ''), 'Unknown') = :fleet_name AND COALESCE(NULLIF(pad_name, ''), 'Unknown') = :pad_name AND (CAST(:well_name AS TEXT) IN ('', '__ALL__') OR name = CAST(:well_name AS TEXT))), latest AS (SELECT MAX(last_record_ts) AS latest_record_ts FROM scoped) SELECT CASE WHEN latest_record_ts IS NOT NULL AND latest_record_ts >= (NOW() - (CAST(:freshness_minutes AS INTEGER) || ' minutes')::interval) THEN 'Live (24 hrs)' ELSE 'Inactive (24 hrs)' END AS status_label, CASE WHEN latest_record_ts IS NOT NULL AND latest_record_ts >= (NOW() - (CAST(:freshness_minutes AS INTEGER) || ' minutes')::interval) THEN true ELSE false END AS is_live, latest_record_ts, CASE WHEN latest_record_ts IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - latest_record_ts)) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) END AS minutes_since_latest FROM latest) q
